item.title: Good Samaritan pulls driver from vehicle on fire after crash in Falmouth
item.description: FALMOUTH – A Good Samaritan pulled a driver from a burning vehicle after it crash in Falmouth about 3:30 AM Sunday. The collision on Ashumet Road near Nathan Ellis Highway (Route 151) woke up the Good Samaritan who called 911 and rushed to the scene. item.title: Car snaps utility pole in Mashpee
item.description: MASHPEE – A car snapped a utility pole in Mashpee about 4 PM Sunday. The crash happened on Red Brook Road by Mashpee Fire Station #2. The driver was evaluated but appeared to have escaped any serious injuries. Mashpee Police are investigating the crash which has Red Brook Road closed in that area. item.description: HYANNIS – Firefighters were called to the Hy-Line Ferry dock on Ocean Street about 5:45 PM Sunday. A fire reportedly broke out on the upper deck of the high speed Grey Lady IV. Crew members were able get the fire under control and the ferry docked and safely evacuated all passengers. item.title: Traffic crash causes delays on Sagamore Bridge
item.description: BOURNE – A traffic crash was reported on the Sagamore Bridge shortly after noon Monday. Mapping showed delays for motorists headed off-Cape. No injuries were reported. About 12:30 PM, a second crash was reported in the backup approaching the scene adding to the delays. No serious injuries were reported.
